title: Validate an identifier using Luhn checksum
summary: A payment form uses the Luhn checksum to catch common digit-entry errors. Validate the supplied identifier using the checksum rules and the input format described in the exercise. Determine whether a digit string passes the Luhn checksum.
requirements: Reject fewer than two digits or any other nondigit character.
Starting from the right, double every second digit and subtract 9 if the result is greater than 9.
hints: Scan digits from right to left.
A valid checksum has a total divisible by ten.
